 Health Canada issued new product recall notices for heated blankets and heating pads sold on Amazon, cannabis sold in Ontario and vapes.
 Metroland has confirmed certain retro refrigerators recalled in Canada were sold through Canadian Tire, in addition to Amazon.
 JKMAX Heated Blankets and Heating Pads 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue Fire and burn hazards.
 Where sold 74 units of the affected products were sold in Canada on Amazon from September 2024 to September 2026.
 What to do Stop using the recalled product immediately and dispose of it in a way that it cannot be used again. 
 The recalled heated blankets and heating pads. 
 Health Canada 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 The packaging of the heated blankets and heating pads. 
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 Brand JKMAX
 Product JKMAX Heated Blankets and Heating Pads
 Description The heated blankets and heating pads are blue, grey, brown or red. They are made of polyester fabric and are machine washable. The blankets and pads were sold in multiple sizes, and both have a detachable white remote that can be used to adjust the heat.
 Model JKMAX-002, JKMAX-7284B, JKMAX-6284B, JKMAX-10090B, JKMAX-8490B and JKMAX-6284B
 Manufacturer Jiande Pengshuai Trading Co., Ltd., China
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 News 
 Health Canada issues product recall notice for heated blankets and heating pads over fire and burn risks 
 Metroland Staff 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW
 Galanz retro refrigerator recall Canada 
 Issue Fire and burn risk
 Where sold 10,045 recalled refrigerators were sold in Canada, including on Amazon and through Canadian Tire, from ​December 2018​ to ​December 2020​
 What to do Immediately stop using, unplug it and contact Galanz to schedule a free in-home repair by a qualified technician.
 Galanz Retro Refrigerators 
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 Only the refrigerators with date codes ranging from December 2018 through December 2020 with the model number GLR76TRDER are impacted. 
 Product name Galanz retro refrigerators
 Colour red
 Size 147 cm high, 61 cm deep and 53 cm wide with 7.6 cubic foot
 UPC codes 686136919715, 190873001171
 Impacted sub-models BCD-215VF-C-62H, BCD-215VF-D-62H
 Description Refrigerators have doors with handles on the left side with handle variations, three adjustable glass shelves, one drawer and one glass shelf. Freezer has a separate door.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Model number and the date code are printed in the MMYYYY format and can be found on a white label on the back of fridge.
 News 
 Appliance sold through Canadian Tire and Amazon recalled 
 Evelyn Harford 
 Ontario cannabis recall: Overtime Punch Out 3.5g 
 Issue Incorrect THC and CBD declarations
 Where sold In Ontario, including through the Ontario Cannabis Store
 Product details 
 Brand Overtime
 Product Punch Out 3.5 g
 Lot No 11185
 Packaged date Sept. 15, 2026
 UPC 00846067005516
 News 
 Cannabis sold in Ontario is recalled 
 Metroland Staff 
 Al Fakher Pro Refill Device Kit 
 Issue Labelling and packaging
 Where sold 1,200 units of the affected products were sold in Canada from ​December 2025​ to ​September 2026.
 What to do Stop using the recalled product immediately and dispose of it
 The recalled  Al Fakher Pro Refill Device Kit.  
 Health Canada 
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Product information found outside the packaging of the recalled product.
 Health Canada 
 Product details 
 Brand/Product Al Fakher Refill Pro Device Kit 
 Volume 20mL
 Colour  Crimson Red, Midnight Black, Sunset Orange, Mint Green, Pure White, Ocean Blue
 Description The product is a Crown Bar hookah-style, reusable, open-fill pod system designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) and direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping
 News 
 Health Canada issues product recall notice for vapes sold in Canada 
 Metroland Staff 
 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) online.
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a consumer product incident report form .
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the cannabis reporting form online.
 Report any drug or health product side effects or complaints to Health Canada.
 You can check for more recall notices published by Health Canada and CFIA online .
